scope: Same-window full HTTP time to first generated delta and first visible content delta, with every sample retained; plus six vision and three tool-call functional checks.

model.mmproj: mmproj-BF16.gguf from the matching model revision

measurement_window.label: pr2-ttft-v2
measurement_window.unchanged_background: GPU1 tts-video/vLLM-omni, ffmpeg and the tslab VM were left running. Same-window arm order controls for background load; it is not an isolated-machine performance claim.

states.first-media: One image; X includes lazy helper process/model startup after the LLM is ready. L initializes mmproj before READY, so its startup is outside this timing.
states.warm-real-encode: The same image with persistent encoder; embedding_cache_mb=0 forces actual re-encoding, cache_prompt=false forbids LLM prefix reuse.
states.video12-warm-encoder: Twelve-second video at 1 fps (12 frames), after image warmup; persistent encoder, actual per-frame encoding, all frames in one Xolotl LLM prefill.

definitions.ttft_s: HTTP request start to first nonempty generated content or reasoning delta; LLM/server startup is excluded.
definitions.visible_ttft_s: HTTP request start to first nonempty visible content delta; reasoning can precede it.

configuration.configuration_note: X F16KV ctx40000 CPU80, lazy helper; L q8_0KV ctx65536 threads64/batch96 ubatch1024, all routed expertsCPU, mmprojCUDA initialized beforeREADY. First-media includes native helper startup; warm means actual re-encode.

memory.method: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=...memory.used,... --format=csv,noheader,nounits; GPU0 device-wide MiB, not a direct NVML byte query.
memory.raw_runner_peak_scope_note: The raw runner labels this telemetry NVML, but its implementation uses nvidia-smi. This receipt records the actual query method.

memory.method: Direct NVML nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo GPU0 device-wide bytes, sampled every0.3s; separate from TTFT nvidia-smi telemetry.

http_quality.background_identity_verification: tts-video container identity and process/VM snapshots retained locally; the per-user virsh lookup for tslab failed in this quality launcher, so no VM-domain-query success is claimed.

limits: Four trials per arm and state; all four values and ranges are retained, with no best-run substitution.
First-media helper startup differs between arms; cold whole-server startup is not compared.
KV type, context and CPU threads differ between the measured native and llama.cpp configurations; these are the tested practical configurations, not equal-kernel settings.
Sampled VRAM methods differ between timing and the dedicated resident-memory/HTTP-quality checks; their peaks must not be treated as one measurement.
Vision6 checks shape/color/order/OCR/count predicates; it is not a general multimodal quality benchmark or a claim of precise video timestamp localization.
Tools3 is a deterministic smoke test, not tools23 or GSM8K100 quality acceptance.
No HIP, SYCL, Windows, other-GPU or multi-GPU timing result is claimed.
